title: Large capacity, easier to clean
text:
Large capacity, easier to clean. I love this dish in general. The size and the ability to hold two large sticks of butter...I really wish that Sweese would sell (or include) the silicone gaskets for their dishes!! I ordered a regular, plain white dish, which did not come with a gasket (I knew this when ordering.)

However, they make an IDENTICAL dish that says "Butter Me Up"...which comes WITH a silicone gasket. Otherwise, the bamboo top fits loosely on the dish, and slides back and forth easily.

I love this dish...the only thing that would make it better, is if it came with a gasket, or even the ability to order one! Trust me, I already reached out to Sweese customer service over this matter, and was flatly told that the gaskets are NOT for sale. Come on Sweese! This is lame, and an EASY fix!

product_metadata.title: Sweese 301.107 Large Butter Dish - Porcelain Keeper with Beech Wooden Lid, Perfect for 2 Sticks of Butter, Steel Blue
features: UPDATED VERSION: BEECH WOODEN LID - Beech is a very hard and tough material. It is also strong, with a close straight grain. Unlike synthetic materials, beech wood will often age gracefully. And with the right maintenance, beech wood can look lovely for many years. It also provides a natural style for your kitchen. Very elegant!

NO MORE MESS THANKS TO THE DEEP DESIGN - The tall and deep design helps stop the butter from sticking to the top of the lid and staying there when you pick up the lid. Without mess, this Sweese modern butter dish adds a touch of elegance to your kitchen.

A PERFECT MATCH FOR MOST BUTTER BRANDS - The container measures 5.5 x 3.6 x 2.6 inches, which is wide and deep enough to hold STANDARD sticks of butter. Works perfectly for both WEST and EAST/EUROPEAN coast butter. A great fit for fans of Kerrygold, Land O'Lakes, Plugra Butter and more.

AS A CUTTING BOARD - The beech wooden lid of butter boat doubles as a small cutting board for slicing. You could use the lid as a butter cutting board. Sweese beech wooden board is the best when it comes to keeping a razor sharp edge on your favorite knife when preparing the butter. So convenient and useful!
PORCELAIN BUTTER CONTAINER - It is more beautiful and safer than the ugly plastic kind of butter dish. The container is made of durable porcelain, chip-resistant and more sturdy than stoneware.
